decision or result: The GPUI+CEF shell (crates/vsesvit-gpui) targets Windows as well as Linux. On Windows it is a build-time choice: the vsesvit crate gets a cargo feature that swaps vsesvit-winui for vsesvit-gpui; WinUI stays the default until the GPUI shell reaches parity. A runtime switch would ship WebView2 and CEF (~200 MB) in one package for no user gain.

CEF glue, state and GPUI views are shared; only native embedding (host window, focus, overlays, screenshots, top-level-at-point) and the message pump differ per OS, behind one platform module with linux/x11 and windows backends.

Riskiest unknown: does a Chrome-style CEF child HWND render, resize and take focus inside GPUI's DirectComposition window (WS_EX_NOREDIRECTIONBITMAP)? GPUI Windows PopUp windows are WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW|WS_EX_TOPMOST and AnchoredPopup is unsupported. Settled by spikes/win-core.

User extensions install through External Extensions JSON with external_crx (packed, location 2): reloads and incognito toggles keep them enabled and Chromium updates them. --load-extension and CDP loadUnpacked reload as unpacked (location 4) and get disabled without developer mode. Dialog-free uninstall is uninstallSelf over the CDP pipe. JSON changes are read at start only.

Action popups must be shell-hosted Alloy child browsers under the action button. activeTab is never granted by a popup, openPopup fails ("no toolbar"), CDP Extensions.triggerAction crashes the browser. Command shortcuts and context-menu items do grant activeTab.

GPUI+CEF works on Windows; self-test 29/0 (rerun by the orchestrator). Must carry: a 31-line GPUI key patch (translate_accelerator swallowed keys for Chromium windows on the GPUI thread), a transparent content area (the DirectComposition target is topmost over child HWNDs), Win32 calls that send to the GPUI window run from a spawned task, SetWindowRgn holes for clickable overlays, PopUp owner + no TOPMOST fix-up, bootstrap.exe + RunWinMain cdylib for the sandbox. External pump recommended over multi_threaded_message_loop.
